request.question: Books cost 60% of list and a pick is 15% off. For a title selling 370 copies a month, does a pick earn or lose money?

reply: Not my shelf. The terminal has no cost data, so I can't show cost, margin or profit, and I can't work anything out from a cost rate you give me. I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value.
